comments.author: kairo
comments.body_html:
I’ve added some config options to the F12 editor for you in v1.2.0!

i originally made it server side only to prevent players from changing their own odds while playing with others using Fika but i see how it can be annoying having to hunt down the file and edit the config with a text editor. (you don’t have to restart the server/game btw, it should auto reload the config just before next roll.)

new server/client options: allowClientOverrides / Allow Client Config

basically, the server and client need each other’s consent for a player to use their own F12 config. if the server allows client overrides, each client can still choose to use the server config or their own custom config.

sadly, the items/messages can’t really be added to the F12 menu without it being messy/annoying (as far as I’m aware), so there’s really only a few config options for the F12 menu, like chance, item count, mode, etc.

let me know if this works for you or if you have any feedback. thanks for the suggestion! <3
